GenApex Micro-Consulting Services

Practical guidance for public sector challenges—fast, focused, and actionable.

Government and utility leaders face decisions every day where a fresh perspective could make a significant difference. GenApex offers productized micro-consulting services for teams who need sharp, actionable insights—without lengthy procurement processes or extended engagements.

Whether you’re evaluating your risk management approach, questioning your capital investment process, or seeking to demonstrate resource efficiency, our hybrid service model delivers:

✅ A professional written analysis tailored to your situation
✅ A 30-minute consultation with a subject matter expert
✅ A clear action roadmap you can implement

General Advisory Packages

Quick Insight – $199

Ideal for: Department heads, project managers, second opinions

  • 2-page expert review (up to 5 input pages)
  • 30-minute consultation call
  • Actionable summary and next steps checklist

Tactical Advisory – $499

Ideal for: Directors, division managers, mid-size teams

  • Architecture, process, or capability review (up to 10 input pages)
  • 5–7 page advisory brief with findings and recommendations
  • 30-minute consultation call
  • Risk and opportunity assessment

Executive Decision Kit – $995

Ideal for: CAOs, CFOs, Directors, elected official briefings

  • Comprehensive evaluation or maturity assessment
  • Executive summary with strategic roadmap outline
  • Decision support framework
  • 30-minute consultation + optional presentation deck (+$200)

Specialized Assessment Packages

Risk Readiness Assessment – $695

For organizations questioning their approach to enterprise risk

Does your organization have enterprise-wide visibility into risks, or do they remain siloed and undocumented? This focused assessment evaluates your current risk management practices against leading practices and provides a practical roadmap for strengthening your approach.

Deliverables:

  • Current state assessment of risk identification and documentation practices
  • Gap analysis against enterprise risk management frameworks
  • Prioritized recommendations for program development
  • 30-minute consultation to discuss findings and next steps

Capital Programming Health Check – $795

For organizations seeking confidence in investment decisions

Are your capital investments driven by integrated lifecycle and performance data, or primarily by asset age and reactive needs? This assessment evaluates your investment planning processes and renewal trigger methodology.

Deliverables:

  • Assessment of current capital prioritization processes
  • Review of renewal trigger methodology (refurbishment vs. replacement)
  • Gap analysis against data-driven investment planning practices
  • Recommendations for process and data improvements
  • 30-minute consultation to discuss implementation approach

Resource Utilization Diagnostic – $695

For organizations seeking to demonstrate efficiency

Can your organization factually demonstrate that public resources are being utilized effectively? This diagnostic evaluates your work management practices and provides recommendations for establishing measurable productivity frameworks.

Deliverables:

  • Assessment of current work management and resource allocation practices
  • Identification of measurement gaps and opportunities
  • Framework recommendations for defensible productivity metrics
  • 30-minute consultation on implementation priorities

Operational Resilience Review – $895

For utilities seeking to shift from reactive to proactive operations

Would your organization detect an emerging infrastructure issue before it impacts service delivery? This review evaluates your monitoring capabilities, alarm systems, and response processes.

Deliverables:

  • Assessment of monitoring and early warning capabilities
  • Review of incident response processes and escalation procedures
  • Gap analysis against proactive operational practices
  • Recommendations for building operational resilience
  • 30-minute consultation to discuss cultural and technical changes

Frequently Asked Questions

Q: What types of documents can I submit?
A: Strategic plans, capital budgets, risk registers, process documentation, organizational charts, policy documents, audit findings—anything relevant to your question.

Q: How long does delivery take?
A: Standard turnaround is 5–7 business days. Expedited 72-hour option available (+$100).

Q: Is this suitable for supporting formal decision-making?
A: Yes. Our assessments are designed to support council reports, steering committee presentations, and executive briefings.

Q: What if I’m not sure which package I need?
A: Book a free 15-minute scoping call and we’ll help you identify the right starting point.

Q: Can these assessments lead to larger engagements?
A: They can, but they don’t have to. Many clients use micro-consulting for specific questions and implement recommendations themselves. Others find the assessment reveals opportunities for deeper work.
